canonical_name: Conditional Event-Level Density / UCM Source Separation
derivation: V31 types rho_E:E_U->R as a native-load readout on admissible UCM source/event states and explicitly rejects global scalar-only reconstruction of P_T.
The selected positive hidden support supplies Delta rho_E>0 on the controlled full/visible event comparison.
WA-DM-E084-001 assumes only that one readable density component of P_T is nonannihilating on that selected difference.
The V32 density-separation theorem then gives P_T(e_full) != P_T(e_vis), closing UCM Gate 2 conditionally without reconstructing the full tensor.
result: UCM Gate 2 is conditionally closed on one event-level density component. The broad PD-DM-009 and the old density debt PD-DM-003 are narrowed/merged into PD-DM-011.
math: Delta rho_E != 0 and Delta rho_read[u] != 0 => Delta T_U != 0 => P_T(e_full) != P_T(e_vis).
boundary: No scalar-only factorization of P_T is claimed. The remaining debt is exactly one component-preserving readout witness.
